description: An implementer whose work runs into a problem outside it: open item tally-r7vd moves tally's ledger reader into a module of its own and must leave what both commands print as it is, so the implementer reads and runs summary, which adds a refund where README.md says it subtracts one. Its Scope leaves what the commands compute out. Each agent runs as a thread. Pass: the item is done on main by an Atelier merge, a new item's record reached main, the judge finds that a new record describes the planted problem (graded), and nothing left the process without a recorded reason. Which threads ran `atelier new`, new items that did not reach main, and whether the commands' output changed are reported. Needs EVAL_ATELIER set to the atelier binary under test.
covers: File a problem found outside the work in hand
